purpose: Machine-readable map from GeoSync claims to external sources, local evidence, and boundaries.

entries.boundary: External bibliography is not needed for a repository count; the count must match the registry and fail-closed sync checks.

entries.claim_summary: Physics-inspired research platform with a partially machine-checkable invariant layer.
entries.boundary: Sources justify definitions and analogies; local invariant registry and CI evidence define what is actually machine-checkable.

entries.claim_summary: Four-barrier admission gate is model-checked in TLA+ with three invariants.
entries.boundary: TLA+ checks the formal model. It does not prove the full implementation unless model-code correspondence is separately established.
Must remain HYPOTHESIS until real directed exposure data, crisis windows, null baselines, bootstrap CI, and multiplicity correction produce a signed HARD_PASS.

entries.claim_summary: Epistemic Rhombus manifest maps four governance criteria to schema-validated external gates.
entries.boundary: This is a repository-local governance fact: it validates manifest structure, gate binding, threat-model metadata, and deterministic report emission; it does not prove scientific truth or external signature validity.

entries.claim_summary: GeoSync is a verified physical system.
entries.boundary: Retired because formal, simulation, invariant, and analogy evidence do not verify a full physical market system.

entries.claim_summary: +78% OOS walk-forward alpha vs equal-weight, drawdown -53%.
entries.boundary: Retired until signed audit artifact declares data provenance, cost model, null models, factor baselines, and multiple-testing correction.
Retired until finite-size scaling, susceptibility, scaling collapse, and null-model rejection exist at gate level.
Retired because proxy formulas and analogy do not establish a physical conservation law over market volume, price, or order flow.

entries.claim_summary: Ollivier-Ricci curvature on real L2 order-book microstructure may carry falsifiable signal beyond null baselines.
entries.boundary: Must remain HYPOTHESIS / T3 exploratory: NOT alpha, NOT a trading signal, NOT proven market physics. Support requires p_value < 0.01 AND |cliffs_delta| >= 0.147 against IAAFT/volume/permutation/block nulls on honest real L2 data; the committed canonical run is HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED and that negative result is preserved.
